visual.name: plumeRadar
visual.description: Radar (spider) chart with the Plume Studio look: axes from several measures or from a category, one polygon per series, a common scale or one scale per axis (automatic), polygon or circular grid, fills, markers and value labels, axis order by name, cross-filtering; premium animated play axis where polygons morph from one period to the next, 0-100 % normalization, axis order by value or custom, % labels, center hole, per-axis bounds and lower-is-better axes, targets, reference series, min-max or quartile bands, period comparison with up / down marks per axis, global score, best and worst axis, smooth curves, polar (rose) bars and small multiples.
